lines: In entry-rest-rise would be own-third-part-rising then; thus this time-abundance breath indeed established.
l4.sanskrit_cite: praveśaviśrāntyullāse syātsvatryaṃśodayastadā etyeṣa kālavibhavaḥ prāṇa eva pratiṣṭhitaḥ
